title: Distordia Product Masterdata Standard (v0.2.0) — Solana realization
description: Solana-blockchain realization of the Distordia Product Masterdata base-layer standard. The LOGICAL schema, field names, semantics, and version are IDENTICAL to the canonical Nexus definition (product.v0.2.0.json); only the on-chain encoding and platform primitives differ. This makes 'product v0.2.0' a multichain standard: the same product, described the same way, addressable on either chain.

equivalentTo.guarantee: Identical field set, types (by width), mutability rules, required set, and semantic version. A record can be mirrored 1:1 between chains; cross-chain equality is by (mfr, art-nr) or gtin/mpn keys.
equivalentTo.differs: Only in encoding (Borsh fixed-size arrays vs Nexus typed JSON fields), addressing, ownership, query mechanism, size headroom, and cost — see crossChainEquivalence.

storageModel.kind: Program-owned account (PDA) holding a fixed-layout, Borsh-encoded struct
storageModel.program: A 'distordia-product-registry' Anchor program owns every product account; the account's runtime owner is the program id.
storageModel.serialization: Borsh, little-endian. String/identifier fields use fixed-size byte arrays ([u8; N], UTF-8, zero-padded) to mirror Nexus fixed maxlength fields and to keep deterministic byte offsets for memcmp queries.
storageModel.accountSize: 545 bytes total (8-byte Anchor discriminator + 537 bytes of fields). Fixed; no realloc needed.
storageModel.rentExempt: ~0.0047 SOL rent-exempt deposit, fully recoverable when the account is closed. Solana's 10 MB per-account ceiling is far above the 545-byte record (Nexus's 1 KB cap is the tighter of the two — the shared format fits both).
storageModel.discriminatorEncodesType: Anchor's 8-byte account discriminator identifies the 'Product' type on-chain; the 'distordia-type' field is retained for cross-chain format parity.

pda.note: Because the PDA address is deterministically derivable BEFORE the create instruction, 'self-addr' is set atomically at initialization (no two-step stamp is needed, unlike on Nexus). art-nr is unique per authority by construction of the seeds.

accountLayout.desc: Asset type identifier. UTF-8 'product', zero-padded. Kept for parity.
This account's own Pubkey; set at init. Mirrors Nexus self-addr; on Solana also natively queryable.
Internal article/SKU number. Unique per authority (PDA seed).
GTIN (EAN/UPC), 8-14 digits, check-digit validated by the program.
Brand name if different from manufacturer.
Prior revision's account address; Pubkey::default() (zeros) = none.
Update authority. Cross-chain equivalent of the Nexus 'owner' genesis. Runtime account owner = program id.
Unix creation time, written by the program from the Clock sysvar at init.
Unix last-modified time, written by the program on each update.
Record version; program increments on each update (mirrors Nexus auto 'version').

rustStruct: // String/identifier fields are fixed-size, zero-padded UTF-8 byte arrays so the
// account has a fixed size and deterministic field offsets (memcmp-filterable),
pub distordia_type: [u8; 16],   // "product"  (discriminator also identifies the type)
pub self_addr:      Pubkey,     // == this account's key; set at init
pub mfr:            [u8; 40],   // manufacturer namespace (not a wallet pubkey)
pub supersedes:     Pubkey,     // prior revision; Pubkey::default() = none
pub authority:      Pubkey,     // update authority (~ Nexus owner/genesis)
pub version:        u32,        // mutable; +1 per update

initialize.summary: Create the product PDA and populate identity fields. self_addr = product.key(); created_ts = modified_ts = Clock now; version = 1; supersedes = default.
initialize.anchorConstraint: #[account(init, payer = authority, space = 8 + Product::SPACE - 8, seeds = [b"product", authority.key().as_ref(), args.art_nr_seed()], bump)]

update.summary: Authority-only edit of MUTABLE fields (status, desc, lifecycle, dq_score). Sets modified_ts = now and version += 1. Attempts to change immutable fields are rejected by the program — this is how Nexus's per-field 'mutable' flag is enforced on Solana.

supersede.summary: Append-only revision: initialize a NEW product account (new rev) whose supersedes = the prior account's key. Identity fields are never mutated in place.

close.summary: Optional: close a draft/erroneous account and reclaim rent to the authority. Production records are typically retired via status='disc', not closed.

queries.byAddress: connection.getAccountInfo(productPubkey) — direct, like Nexus get-by-address (and unlike Nexus, natively available without the self-addr workaround).
queries.byField: connection.getProgramAccounts(programId, { filters: [{ memcmp: { offset, bytes }}] }) using offsets from accountLayout. Examples: gtin -> offset 144; art-nr -> offset 72; authority -> offset 492; mat-type -> offset 158.
queries.note: memcmp matches the raw fixed-array bytes (zero-padded UTF-8). For production-scale search, index via Geyser/Helius/DAS, mirroring Nexus register indexing.

crossChainEquivalence.solana: Account Pubkey (base58, 32 bytes); a PDA here

crossChainEquivalence.nexus: Required; stamped in a 2nd tx because address is unknown at create AND not query-filterable
crossChainEquivalence.solana: Set atomically at init (PDA derivable up front); accounts are natively queryable — kept only for cross-chain parity
'authority' Pubkey field (program-enforced); runtime account owner = program id
Same namespace strings (NOT wallet pubkeys) — preserved for format equality

crossChainEquivalence.nexus: Enforced by the register from each field's 'mutable' flag
crossChainEquivalence.solana: Enforced by the program's update handler (immutable fields rejected)
New account, supersedes = prior account Pubkey
10 MB per-account ceiling; this record is 545 bytes
getProgramAccounts + memcmp at field offset, or DAS/Geyser indexer
~0.0047 SOL rent-exempt deposit (recoverable) + ~0.000005 SOL tx fee

example._comment: Product account as returned by getAccountInfo + Anchor decode. Same business values as the Nexus product.v0.2.0 example. On-chain Rust field names are snake_case; shown here in kebab-case to mirror the Nexus JSON view. Byte arrays decode to trimmed UTF-8.

tokenExtensionsAlternative._comment: Optional realization for products that are also tokenized.
tokenExtensionsAlternative.model: Token-2022 (Token Extensions) mint with the Metadata extension. Store the same fields as additional_metadata key-value pairs (keys identical to the field names here) plus a MetadataPointer to the mint itself.
tokenExtensionsAlternative.tradeoffs: Pros: product is a first-class SPL token, tradable/transferable, wallet-visible. Cons: key-value metadata is unindexed by offset (no memcmp); values are UTF-8 strings (lose numeric typing); per-mint setup cost is higher. Use the custom-program PDA model (above) when the product is a catalogue record, and this model when the product IS a token.

notes: Multichain by design: identical field names, semantics, required set, and semantic version (0.2.0) as product.v0.2.0.json on Nexus. Only encoding/platform primitives differ.

Fixed-size [u8; N] arrays (not Borsh String) are used so the account size is fixed and every field sits at a deterministic offset, making getProgramAccounts/memcmp the true analog of Nexus WHERE queries.
self-addr is redundant on Solana (accounts are addressable and queryable natively) but is retained for cross-chain format equality and to let off-chain tooling treat both chains uniformly.
mfr and steward remain Distordia namespace strings on both chains; they are NOT replaced by Solana wallet pubkeys. The 'authority' field is the Solana-native creator/owner equivalent.

Companion MRP layers (product-plan, product-source, product-bom-line, ...) map to additional PDA account types under the same registry program, each referencing the product via its Pubkey — exactly mirroring the Nexus 'product = <core self-addr>' linkage.
Successor draft alongside product.v0.2.0.json (Nexus). Program id, PDA, and example addresses shown are illustrative placeholders.
